about: Nodes of the meteorology lineage graph, type "model": what computes the forecast. Ids are stable (incident.entities@ may adopt them); meaning is in the edges (meteorology/edges/), not here.

nodes.name: ECMWF IFS
nodes.summary: The Integrated Forecasting System: ECMWF's global physics-based model (high-resolution and ensemble forecasts, four runs a day).

nodes.name: ECMWF AIFS
nodes.summary: ECMWF's Artificial Intelligence Forecasting System: a machine-learned global model run operationally beside IFS, with open outputs and open weights.

nodes.name: GFS (NOAA/NCEP)
nodes.summary: The Global Forecast System: the United States' global model, four runs a day, outputs in the public domain.

nodes.name: ICON (DWD)
nodes.summary: Germany's ICOsahedral Nonhydrostatic model: global, with nested ICON-EU and the convection-permitting ICON-D2.

nodes.name: ARPEGE (Météo-France)
nodes.summary: Météo-France's global model with a stretched grid, finest over France and coarser on the far side of the globe.

nodes.name: AROME (Météo-France)
nodes.summary: Météo-France's convection-permitting regional model (about 1.3 km), the family several European services run over their own territory.

nodes.name: HARMONIE-AROME (AEMET and the ACCORD consortium)
nodes.summary: The configuration of AROME run by AEMET over the Iberian Peninsula and the Canaries, and by the Nordic and Dutch services.

nodes.name: Met Office Unified Model
nodes.summary: The United Kingdom's model: one code for global and for the kilometre-scale UKV forecasts.

nodes.name: MEPS (MetCoOp)
nodes.summary: The Nordic services' shared ensemble of HARMONIE-AROME; it covers the Nordic area only, so a forecast for Lisbon from MET Norway's API comes from ECMWF.

nodes.name: GraphCast (Google DeepMind)
nodes.summary: A machine-learned global model published with code and weights; trained on ECMWF reanalysis.

nodes.name: Pangu-Weather (Huawei)
nodes.summary: A machine-learned global model published with its trained weights for non-commercial use.

nodes.name: Aurora (Microsoft)
nodes.summary: A machine-learned foundation model of the atmosphere published with code and weights.

nodes.name: FourCastNet (NVIDIA and others)
nodes.summary: An early machine-learned global model published with code.
